title: Withholding of Booked Late-Cancellation Fees from Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Refunds
content:
On the refund of a cancelled prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom or Spa Groom pass), the late-cancellation fees booked on the pass are withheld in a share that depends on how many such fee entries the pass carries.

**Rule.** The share of the late-cancellation fees withheld from the refund follows how many late-cancellation fee entries the pass carries:

| Late-cancellation fee entries on the pass | Share of the fees booked that is withheld |
|---|---|
| exactly one | 0.5 |
| exactly two | 0.75 |
| none, or three or more | in full |

The fees booked are the total of the amounts on those entries; the share withheld is subtracted from the refund.

**Illustrations (hypothetical entries in the salon history of a pass)**

| Entries and amounts | Fees booked | Withheld from the refund |
|---|---|---|
| one entry of 20.00 | 20.00 | 10.00 |
| two entries of 20.00 and 16.50 | 36.50 | 27.375, before the final rounding of the refund |
| three entries of 15.00 each | 45.00 | 45.00 |
| none | 0.00 | 0.00 |
